description: ERP Business Logic Rules - Injected into SQL Architect prompt at runtime

mandatory_filters.description: Filters that MUST be applied for specific calculation types

rules.name: Revenue/Ciro Calculation
rules.explanation: Ciro hesaplanırken iptal, iade, ikram ve fire işlemleri hariç tutulmalıdır

rules.name: KDV Hariç Tutar Calculation

mandatory_conditions.description: Divide by 1.20 to get VAT-excluded amount (assuming 20% VAT)

rules.explanation: KDV hariç tutar hesaplanırken toplam tutarı 1.20'ye bölün (20% KDV varsayımı)

rules.name: Open/Active Tables

mandatory_conditions.description: Filter for open tables (payment not received)

rules.explanation: Açık masa sorguları için IsTableActive=1 filtresi zorunludur

rules.name: Complimentary/İkram Transactions
rules.explanation: İkram sorguları için DocumentDetailIsTreatWasteCancel=1 filtresi zorunludur

rules.name: Waste/Fire Transactions
rules.explanation: Fire/zayi sorguları için DocumentDetailIsTreatWasteCancel=2 filtresi zorunludur

rules.name: Cancelled/İptal Transactions
rules.explanation: İptal sorguları için DocumentDetailIsTreatWasteCancel=3 filtresi zorunludur

column_transformations.description: Column-level transformation rules for specific calculations

transformations.name: KDV Hariç Tutar
transformations.description: Divide amount by 1.20 to exclude 20% VAT

rules.name: Adisyon Toplam Tutarı

aggregation.description: Group by DocumentId to get invoice/table total

rules.explanation: Adisyon toplam tutarı hesaplanırken GROUP BY DocumentId kullanılmalıdır

rules.name: Menu vs Standalone Products
rules.description: MenuId NULL or Empty Guid = main product, otherwise menu option

semantic_mappings.description: Common user queries and their proper SQL interpretation

mappings.sql_interpretation: ORDER BY SUM(Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1 or TOP 1
ORDER BY SUM(Quantity) ASC LIMIT 1 or TOP 1
ORDER BY SUM(RowAmount) DESC with revenue filters applied

validation_rules.description: Pre-execution validation rules to catch common errors

rules.check: If GROUP BY includes DocumentId, ensure SUM/COUNT is not applied to row-level fields without proper context
rules.error_message: Adisyon bazlı gruplama ile satır bazlı aggregation çakışması

rules.check: Date filters should use CAST(DocumentDate AS DATE) for date-only comparisons
rules.error_message: Tarih filtreleri CAST(DocumentDate AS DATE) kullanmalıdır

performance_hints.description: Query optimization hints for better performance

hints.description: Always filter on DocumentDate first if date range is specified (indexed column)
hints.example: WHERE CAST(DocumentDate AS DATE) >= '2024-01-01' AND BranchName = 'X'

hints.description: Avoid SELECT * when only specific columns are needed
hints.example: SELECT ProductName, SUM(RowAmount) instead of SELECT *
